newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan farm finance bodies accept Nichiboshin plan.
newsitem.headline: Japan farm finance bodies accept Nichiboshin plan.

text.p: Non-bank financial institution Nichiboshin Ltd said on Tuesday that agricultural financial institutions among its creditors had told it they would accept Nichiboshin's restructuring plan.
Nichiboshin believes that its other creditors would also accept the plan, partly encouraged by the agricultural financial institutions' acceptance, a Nichiboshin spokesman said.
Nichiboshin did not comment further on its other creditors.

Financial bodies belonging to the National Mutual Insurance Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives and the national body itself told Nichiboshin that they would accept the non-bank's five-year restructuring plan, an official of National Mutual said.
Nichiboshin formed the restructuring programme in September 1995, under which it called for its more than 100 creditors to forgive some of their loans.

A Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that Nichboshin's five-year plan called for the creditors to forgive a total of 500 billion yen -- 100 billion yen each year -- in loans to the non-bank.
The Nichiboshin spokesman declined to comment on the figures.
